subtasks.title: GPS-position automated check-in recorder (DEV-1756 spec, Oscar-clarified)
subtasks.approach: A scheduled backend command that, per Scout-enabled kit, pulls the kit's recent sc_positions GPS fixes and matches each against that kit's OPEN direct + OPEN staging order addresses (reusing ScoutCheckInRollupQuery's existing open/direct/staging address enumeration + bbox-prefilter + geoDistance<=160.934m), recording one check-in per (kit, address, hour) idempotently. Running count per address = derived aggregate over the events table. No watermark table needed: each run scans a sliding 15-min lookback window (3x the 5-min cadence) and the (kit_id,address_id,hour_bucket) unique index + ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING makes overlapping re-processing a no-op. UI stays hidden; live-map indicator is a future follow-up.
subtasks.intended_diffs: migration: Schema::connection('platform')->create('scout_check_ins', ...): id, kit_id (uBigInt), org_id (uInt), hotlist_id (uBigInt), address_id (uBigInt), is_staged (bool), matched_at (timestampTz), hour_bucket (timestampTz), lat (double), lng (double), timestamps; unique(['kit_id','address_id','hour_bucket']); index(['org_id','address_id']); explicit down(). model ScoutCheckIn: $connection='platform', fillable, casts() (matched_at/hour_bucket datetime). query ScoutCheckInMatchQuery: given kit_mapping + org_id + staging_org_ids + start/end window, returns distinct (address_id, hotlist_id, is_staged, hour_bucket, lat, lng) matches = sc_positions (lower(kit_mapping)=?, timestamp_utc in window) within geoDistance<=160.934m of open direct/staging addresses (bbox prefilter + id-prune, reuse ScoutCheckInRollupQuery's CTE shape but source=sc_positions not scans, and GROUP/dedup by (address, hour)). command scout:record-check-ins {--since= optional}: gated config('app.experimental.clarity_scout'); enumerate Scout kits (whereNotNull kit_mapping + KitSettings + clarity-scout perm + CLARITY_SCOUT flag); per kit resolve org_id + Org::stagingOrgIds() + kit_mapping; window = now-15min..now (or --since); run ScoutCheckInMatchQuery (cache:false); upsert rows into scout_check_ins via updateOrCreate/ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING on (kit_id,address_id,hour_bucket); per-kit try/catch skip-and-log. schedule: Schedule::command('scout:record-check-ins')->when(clarity_scout flag)->everyFiveMinutes()->withoutOverlapping()->runInBackground()->onOneServer(). test: RequiresClickhouse — seed a Scout kit + open direct/staging address + sc_positions fixes near/far the address within a window; run command; assert scout_check_ins rows (one per kit/address/hour, correct is_staged), idempotent re-run (no dupes), far-position excluded, non-Scout kit skipped, flag-off no-op.

decisions.scope: OPEN direct + OPEN staging orders only (Oscar: group by assignment type, historical/HH/AA out of scope) — reuse ScoutCheckInRollupQuery's existing open/direct/staging address scope, no change to it
decisions.dedup: one check-in per (kit, address, hour) — Oscar confirmed (matches today's on-read logic); enforced by unique index + ON CONFLICT
decisions.cadence: every 5 min (everyFiveMinutes) with a 15-min idempotent sliding lookback — PERF-VALIDATED (per-kit read ~120ms index-bounded; fleet ~150 kits; well within the 5-min budget). Near-real-time per Oscar's preference.
decisions.watermark: none — sliding lookback + idempotent unique index (simpler than a per-kit watermark store)
decisions.read_endpoint: left live/unchanged; UI hidden (live-map indicator = future follow-up)

perf_validation.reason: Measured on prod CH Cloud: per-kit windowed read ~120ms regardless of the 255M-row total (PK-range access); fleet ~150 kits; per-cycle sweep well within a 5-min budget.

sizing.note: at the 6-file line; single cohesive concern (the recorder). Surfacing cadence/perf judgment to Dalton before build.
